text:
Aisha (Design): uploaded a new iteration of the Trace Inspector wireflow for review — compact + expanded panes. figma: https://figma.com/file/trace-inspector-wireflow :eyes:
Aisha (Design): main asks: microcopy for frame controls, export affordance clarity, and keyboard/assistive flow. keeping small-laptop real-estate in mind.
Tom (Eng): looking. quick question: do frame actions live inline or in a contextual menu? for keyboard we prefer a single menu per frame to avoid tab bloat.
Aisha (Design): proposed: three-dot menu per frame with items: Open source, Copy frame link, Copy correlation id, Expand all below. primary action inline is the frame title which expands details.
Lena (Eng-UX): accessibility: three-dot must have aria-haspopup="menu" and aria-expanded when open. ensure menu gets focus and ESC closes it.
Tom (Eng): code hint for menu button role:
```
<button aria-haspopup="true" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="frame-123-menu">…</button>
```
Ravi (Product): copy wording notes: avoid nouns that hide intent. prefer "Expand frames" over "Show stack"; "Export trace (HAR)" explicit in menu. users repeatedly asked what format Export means.
Aisha (Design): agree. redesigning export to be a split button: primary "Export" with format label and caret for options. tooltip shows last-used format.
Lena (Eng-UX): keyboard flows: include a visible "Skip to frames" link at modal top for screen readers/tab users. make it focusable and visible on focus. add id on frames region.
Tom (Eng): for correlation id copy, thinking of a chip with role="button" + aria-label="Copy correlation id <id>". Enter/Space should copy and fire a polite live region update.
Aisha (Design): microcopy proposed for chip: visible text is the id, hidden tooltip/action label "Copy ID". after copy show ephemeral label "Copied!" in tooltip.
Lena (Eng-UX): contrast nits: timestamp & helper text use #6b7280 which fails 4.5:1 on 12px. propose #374151 or increase to 13px semibold. also ensure focus rings meet contrast.
Tom (Eng): implementation notes: use navigator.clipboard.writeText with try/catch fallback to document.execCommand for hosted webviews. publish telemetry on success/failure. toasts should be aria-live="polite".
Ravi (Product): routing/telemetry: current backend route /trace/:id/export exists. product prefers docs use /trace/:id/download — suggest aliasing but keep export endpoint stable. logging should include format param (har/json).
Aisha (Design): UX question: for long stacks should we show top 3 frames inline and a "Show all (12)" control or default fully collapsed?
Lena (Eng-UX): default collapsed for >6 frames helps scanning. show top 2 frames + "Show all (n)" link. indicate collapsed count in parentheses. ensure SR reads "Show all 12 frames" not just "Show all".
Tom (Eng): agreed. we can lazy-load deeper frames on expand to save payloads. add a11y note: set aria-hidden on collapsed content and update aria-expanded on the container.
Aisha (Design): export menu options: Export trace (HAR), Export trace (JSON), Copy trace link. default to HAR for downstream tools.
Ravi (Product): we should track export format selection as a metric and maybe surface last-used format as default per-user. also add an A/B card to test collapsed-by-default vs expanded for mean triage time.
Lena (Eng-UX): small SVG timeline alt text suggestion: each bar should have aria-label like "50ms in service X" and a data-keyboard-focusable rect for keyboard users. also ensure hit target is >=44px.
ops-bot: automated a11y scan results: 2 warnings - low contrast on timestamp, and missing aria-expanded on sample chevrons. CI: https://ci.internal/scan/17823
Tom (Eng): I'll add aria attributes, keyboard menu behavior, clipboard fallback and toasts. will include unit tests for aria states. planning PR in next sprint.
Aisha (Design): I'll update figma copy, add focus-state frames, and post screenshots of keyboard walkthrough after lunch.
Ravi (Product): I'll add the export metric + A/B test ticket to the backlog and sync with analytics.
Lena (Eng-UX): will prepare a11y checklist and a short keyboard-only video for the design review.
Aisha (Design): thanks everyone — will re-request review after changes. :thumbsup:
